task_completion.description: The agent successfully loads the abdominal CT scan into the medical imaging software (e.g., 3Slicer).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 3D or multi-planar (axial, sagittal, coronal) view of an abdominal CT scan is visible in the application workspace.

task_completion.description: The agent positions the cursor or a probe over the aorta to sample the intensity.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The cursor or a measurement tool is positioned over the descending or abdominal aorta (the large circular vessel near the spine).

task_completion.description: The agent positions the cursor or a probe over the liver parenchyma.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The cursor or a measurement tool is positioned over the large organ on the patient's right side (left side of the screen in axial view).

task_completion.description: The agent positions the cursor or a probe over the spleen.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The cursor or a measurement tool is positioned over the organ on the patient's left side (right side of the screen in axial view).

task_completion.description: The agent creates and saves the intensity_measurements.txt file with the required content.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows the file ~/Documents/SlicerData/intensity_measurements.txt containing the formatted strings for Aorta, Liver, Spleen, and Interpretation.

integrity.description: The agent used the medical imaging software GUI to find values rather than just guessing.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor moving over the anatomical regions and the 'Data Probe' or 'Value' display in the GUI updating.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the privileged information ranges without performing measurements.
integrity.visual_evidence: The values in the text file should be specific integers (e.g., 182 HU) rather than ranges (e.g., 150-250 HU).

integrity.description: The agent saved the file to the specific requested directory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file path ~/Documents/SlicerData/intensity_measurements.txt is visible in the save dialog or terminal command.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The expected Hounsfield Unit (HU) ranges for this specific CT (amos_0001) are: Aorta (150-250 HU), Liver (40-80 HU), and Spleen (40-60 HU). Allow for a tolerance of +/- 30 HU. The agent must record specific values found at these landmarks, not the ranges themselves.
